name: Electromin
verdict: Electromin is the EV-charging subsidiary of Petromin Corporation, part of the family-owned Al-Dabbagh Group. Nothing found.
note: Global sponsor of Nissan Formula E Team under a four-year agreement that began in Season 11 (2024/25); a Petromin business launched in 2020. Saudi-registered private company; no state ownership or human-rights finding identified.
